evidence.detail: The class recognizes <timg=...> opening markup, delegates its parameter section to the same RichTextImageSpec parser, and requires a matching </timg> close tag.
It captures the text between the opening specification and </timg> and caches the resulting labeled-image spec by String identity and source range.

The live font renderer transforms/draws the specified sprite, then if the captured label is non-empty measures it and renders it centered horizontally over the image with isolated white/default text state.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 processor for timg embedded images with centered enclosed labels.

evidence.detail: The immutable record holds the underlying RichTextImageSpec, copies its sprite id/transform code into public convenience fields, stores the enclosed label String, and stores the closing-tag end index.
RichTextLabeledImageProcessor is the only exact-v308 constructor and the live font renderer consumes all retained fields while drawing the timg element.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 parsed timg image-plus-label specification.

evidence.detail: The immutable record stores exactly five parsed integers used by embedded-image rendering: sprite id, transform code, size adjustment, optional inner/frame color and outer color.
Its predicate reports whether the optional frame color is present, and its padding helper returns the extra two-pixel frame inset used by the live renderer.
RichTextImageSpecParser is the only exact-v308 constructor/owner; the font renderer consumes the record directly.
The class maintains a 128-entry source/result sprite cache keyed by source sprite identity plus two transform integers, with four-way collision slots per 32 buckets.

On cache miss it allocates a new rs/l/F sprite whose width/height are the source dimensions plus the parsed size adjustment, resamples source pixels into the new dimensions, and applies the requested color transform while preserving alpha.
The live font renderer invokes this transform for both ordinary <img=...> specs and timg labeled-image specs before drawing the embedded sprite.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 cache for transformed embedded rich-text sprites.

evidence.detail: The class recognizes <img=...> and parses up to five colon-delimited fields: decimal sprite id, decimal transform code, decimal size adjustment, optional RGB/hex frame color, and optional RGB/hex outer color.
Parsing bounds sprite id to 100000, transform code to 511, size adjustment to 99, and RGB values to 24 bits; parsed specs are cached in a 256-slot String-identity/range cache.
rs/l/h and rs/l/k use the parser during live text layout/rendering; the resulting spec selects/transforms the sprite and optionally draws a two-layer rectangular frame around it.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 parser/cache for embedded rich-text image specifications.
